title: Khalil Shakir stands out in Bills' opening weeks
seoTitle: Khalil Shakir stands out in Bills' opening weeks
subtitle: Offensive player comes into focus after decisive play against the Houston Texans
excerpt: Buffalo Bills newcomer Khalil Shakir drew attention for nearly causing a turnover against the Texans and being mentioned by Josh Allen as part of the.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Khalil Shakir began to be mentioned in the Buffalo Bills' coaching staff discussions in the very first weeks of the 2026 season. Attention to his name arose after a play against the Houston Texans that almost turned into a pick-six, as well as comments from Josh Allen, who mentioned the receiver in an interview.

Play that almost became a pick-six

During the 36-31 victory over the Houston Texans, quarterback Josh Allen threw an incomplete pass to Khalil Shakir that nearly resulted in an interception returned for a touchdown. The play was highlighted in the game report, emphasizing how close the mistake was to changing the outcome.

Josh Allen's comment on practice

In an interview before the game against the Texans, Josh Allen mentioned Khalil Shakir when talking about the team's practices. The quarterback emphasized the confidence he has in his receivers, including Shakir, when planning the team's offense.

Positioning in the offensive plan

Coaches' press notes indicate that the Bills' offense has been looking to diversify its passing options, with special attention to players like DJ Moore and Dalton Kincaid. Although Shakir was not mentioned as a primary target, his presence in practice was highlighted as part of the strategy to expand the range of threats to the opposing defense.

Expectations for the upcoming games

With the season still in its early stages, the Bills' coaching staff seems confident that Khalil Shakir will have opportunities to contribute more consistently. Allen's mention and the reference to the play against the Texans suggest that the player is being integrated into the offensive scheme and could gain more snaps in the coming weeks.

Conclusion of the initial phase

The start of the season brought visibility to Khalil Shakir within the Bills' group, both due to a near-decisive play and comments from team leaders. It remains to be seen how the receiver will progress throughout the campaign, especially on a roster that already features prominent names in the receiving corps.

With information from NFL.com, Buffalo Bills.
